name: Kettlebell Deadlift
steps: Stand with a kettlebell centered between your ankles, feet slightly wider than hip-width, and toes turned slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees with a flat spine to reach straight down and grasp the handle firmly with both hands.
Brace your abdomen and press through your feet to extend your hips and knees together.
Hinge smoothly back at the hips and bend your knees to set the kettlebell back down between your feet under control.
tips: Keep the kettlebell directly between your arches rather than in front of your toes.
Finish tall by squeezing your glutes without leaning backward at the top.
